Order confirmed

That’s your Sparky.

Stripe has your payment and your delivery address. A receipt is on its way to the email you paid with.

What happens next

  1. We build and test your boxIt gets set up, updated and checked before it leaves us.
  2. It arrives, with an invitation codePlug it in, connect it to your home network, and open http://sparky.local from a device on the same network.
  3. You enter the code, and it’s yoursSetup takes a few minutes. After that you ask Sparky for what you want.

If you want a large film library, add a hard drive. Sparky will tell you what it needs and set it up when you plug it in.

If something’s wrong

Email hello@sparky-box.com and a person will answer. You have 14 days from the day it arrives to change your mind for any reason, and your statutory rights are unaffected — the terms have the detail.
